discovery_confirm.title: Novolto heating rod found
discovery_confirm.description: Serial number: **{serial}** · Water temperature: {water_temp} °C · last seen: {age} ago. Choose a name and the model.

data_description.name: Shown in the dashboard and determines the entity IDs (e.g. `water_heater.novolto_p3000`). With several heating rods choose different names, e.g. "Heating rod basement". Renaming later does not change the entity IDs.
data_description.model: See the type plate. Sets the defaults, e.g. the maximum power (P2300: 2300 W, P3000: 3000 W).

discovery_confirm_offline.title: Novolto heating rod found
discovery_confirm_offline.description:
Serial number: **{serial}** · Water temperature: {water_temp} °C · last seen: {age} ago. Choose a name and the model.

Caution: The heating rod hasn't reported for {age} and is probably switched off right now. You can set it up anyway.

data_description.name: Shown in the dashboard and determines the entity IDs (e.g. `water_heater.novolto_p3000`). With several heating rods choose different names, e.g. "Heating rod basement". Renaming later does not change the entity IDs.
data_description.model: See the type plate. Sets the defaults, e.g. the maximum power (P2300: 2300 W, P3000: 3000 W).

select.title: Select heating rod
select.description: {count} heating rod(s) found. Not listed? Check that the heating rod is switched on and connected to the broker ([guide]({readme_url})), or enter the topic yourself.

manual.title: Enter MQTT topic
manual.description: The MQTT topic is shown in the configuration of the heating rod under the MQTT settings. Unless changed, it is the serial number in the format `AAA.BBB.123456` (mind upper and lower case). To open the configuration: press the button on the heating rod once briefly → the heating rod opens a WiFi hotspot → open the configuration through it (Novolto provides the login).

data_description.topic: Only the topic, without `/info` at the end and without spaces.

no_data.title: No data on {topic}
no_data.description: No message from this heating rod within 35 seconds. Common causes: typo in the topic · heating rod off or without network connection (WiFi or LAN cable) · heating rod sends to a different MQTT broker · wrong user or password in the configuration of the heating rod.

no_data_case.title: No data on {topic}
no_data_case.description: No message from this heating rod within 35 seconds. Common causes: typo in the topic · heating rod off or without network connection (WiFi or LAN cable) · heating rod sends to a different MQTT broker · wrong user or password in the configuration of the heating rod. Found was **{found}** – did you mean this one?

anyway.title: Set up without connection?
anyway.description: All values stay "Unavailable" until the heating rod sends data. If there is still no data after 10 minutes, a message appears under Settings → Repairs.

data_description.name: Shown in the dashboard and determines the entity IDs (e.g. `water_heater.novolto_p3000`). With several heating rods choose different names, e.g. "Heating rod basement". Renaming later does not change the entity IDs.
data_description.model: See the type plate. Sets the defaults, e.g. the maximum power (P2300: 2300 W, P3000: 3000 W).

reconfigure.title: Change MQTT topic
reconfigure.description: Only needed if you changed the topic in the configuration of the heating rod. Device, entities and energy counter are kept.

data_description.topic: Only the topic, without `/info` at the end and without spaces.

progress.search: Searching for Novolto heating rods … This can take up to 35 seconds because the heating rod only sends measurements every 30 seconds.
progress.listen: Waiting for data from the heating rod … This can take up to 35 seconds because the heating rod only sends measurements every 30 seconds.

error.invalid_topic: That doesn't look like a valid topic. Enter it without spaces, `+` or `#` and without `/info` at the end.
error.none_found: No heating rod found. Check that it is switched on and connected to the broker, or enter the topic yourself.
error.name_taken: Another heating rod already uses this name. Please choose a different name.
error.topic_in_use: Another heating rod is already set up with this topic.
error.other_device: A different heating rod ({serial}) sends on this topic. Please enter the correct topic.

abort.mqtt_not_configured: Home Assistant needs an MQTT broker and the MQTT integration first. How to: 1. [Install and start the Mosquitto broker add-on]({addon_url}) 2. [Set up the MQTT integration]({mqtt_url}) 3. Connect the heating rod to the broker ([guide]({readme_url})). Then add this integration again.
abort.mqtt_not_connected: The MQTT integration is set up but not connected to the broker. Check that the Mosquitto add-on is running and the MQTT integration shows no error.
abort.already_configured: This heating rod is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this heating rod is already in progress.
abort.not_novolto_device: The device found is not a Novolto heating rod.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Advanced settings (view only): power step {power_step} W · "Heating" threshold {threshold} W · target temperature min. {sptw_min} °C · switching differential {sptwh_min}–{sptwh_max} °C · timeout {timeout} s · topics {topic_info} / {topic_control}

data_description.power_stages: Values in watts, separated by commas, e.g. `0, 1000, 2000, 3000`. 0 means off. Note: the heating rod reaches in-between values (e.g. 1500 W) by switching between whole 1000 W stages - the actual power then fluctuates (e.g. 1500 W → 1000–2000 W). For a steady grid load use whole stages only.
data_description.model: Sets the defaults for the heating rod (maximum power, suggested power stages).
data_description.sptw_max: The target temperature can't be set higher - neither in the dashboard nor by automations. The water gets up to switching differential/2 warmer than set.

high_temperature.title: Caution: high water temperature
high_temperature.description: You chose a maximum target temperature of {temperature} °C. Water temperatures above 50 °C can cause scalding at the tap. In addition, the water gets up to switching differential/2 warmer than set. Only confirm if a protection is in place (e.g. mixing valve/anti-scald device).

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: ⚠ Caution: wrong values can lead to unwanted behaviour and problems. Only change them if you know what you are doing.

data_description.power_step: Step of the target power slider.
data_description.heating_threshold_w: From this measured power on the heating rod counts as "Heating".
data_description.sptw_min: Lowest target temperature that can be set.
data_description.sptwh_min: Range of the switching differential slider.
data_description.sptwh_max: Range of the switching differential slider. Example: 60 °C target and 10 °C switching differential → heats below 55 °C, stops above 65 °C.
data_description.timeout_seconds: Time without a message until the heating rod counts as "Unavailable". At least three times the measurement interval is always waited.
data_description.topic_info: Only change if the heating rod uses different topic names.
data_description.topic_control: Only change if the heating rod uses different topic names.
data_description.reset_defaults: Resets all advanced values to the defaults.

error.stages_invalid: Only whole numbers between 0 and {max_power} W, separated by commas.
error.stages_no_zero: The list must contain 0, otherwise the heating rod can't be switched off via the power stage.
error.confirm_required: Please confirm or choose a value up to 50 °C.
error.invalid_topic_suffix: Please enter a name without spaces, `/`, `+` or `#`.
error.same_topic: Info and control topic must be different.
error.min_not_below_max: The maximum must be greater than the minimum.

temperature_out_of_range.message: Target temperature {temperature} °C is outside {min_temp}–{max_temp} °C. The limits can be changed in the integration options.

device_offline.message: {name} is not reachable - the setting was not sent.

mqtt_unavailable.message: MQTT broker not reachable, retrying automatically.

no_data.title: {name} sends no data
no_data.description: No measurements for {minutes} minutes. Check power, network connection (WiFi or LAN) and the MQTT settings in the configuration of the heating rod. Note: without a connection the heating rod keeps heating with the last values set.

setting_rejected.title: {name} rejected a setting
setting_rejected.description: Error code {ret}: {s_err}. The previous value stays active.

stale_retained.title: {name}: outdated stored message on the broker

confirm.title: Delete stored message?
confirm.description: The MQTT broker has stored an old message of this heating rod (from {date}). It is shown briefly after every Home Assistant restart because "retain" has since been switched off on the heating rod. Confirming deletes the stored message. Nothing changes on the heating rod.

abort.device_not_loaded: The heating rod is not loaded right now. Try again later.

stb_tripped.title: {name}: safety temperature limiter tripped
stb_tripped.description: The overheating protection of the heating rod has tripped. Check the heating rod and the tank, contact Novolto support if necessary.
